description:
Reported liquidation prices for current Hyperliquid positions in one token, from Nansen only (provider=nansen). Defaults to BTC and the first 100 positions. Returns one provider page with position side, size/value, leverage, and nullable liquidation prices. Page numbers are 1-10000; page size is 1-100; token symbols are at most 40 characters. These are reported open-position levels on Hyperliquid, not executed liquidation events or an estimated cross-exchange liquidation heatmap.

[Access: pay 0.02 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]

provider.description: Optional upstream override; omitted uses the existing server default.

token_symbol.description: Token whose perpetual positions to read, e.g. BTC.

name: get_liquidation_levels
